day_local: NgoLwesine Weveki Yamashumi Amabini anesine Kwixesha Eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oNgcwele. Makube kuye kuse nendawonye nani.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Bulekani eNkosini, ngokuba ilungile; ngokuba inceba yayo iyahlala naphezulu.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso ohlala unamathele ezandleni zikaBenjamin Vo xa wayesaphila. Awusisiqalo sencwadi okanye ilizwi elikhulu; ngumzuzu omncinci apho uBen wayehlezi ecaleni kukayise, ephethe iphepha elincinci okanye isixhobo sokusebenza, encumile kwaye echaza ngesigama esithile sokuba indiza ingaphapha njani ngcono. Wayengenamabandla okanye ukuzigqaja; wayengumfana owayenomdla onzulu wokubona ihlabathi lisebenza, ngeliso elibukhali kodwa ngentliziyo eyayisoloko ithambile. UBen wayeyazi ukuba ubomi abubalulekanga ngobungakanani bolwazi lomntu, kodwa bubalulekile ngobungakanani bothando alunikezelayo.

Namhlanje, uPawulos oNgcwele usikhumbuza amazwi anzulu kwiNcwadi eya kwabaseKorinte: 'Ngububele bukaThixo obenza ukuba ndibe yiloo ndiyiyo.' La magama awakho nje ekuthetheni; ayisisiqalo esibonisa ukuba ubomi bomntu ngamnye buxhunywe kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen wayephila ngaloo ndlela. Khumbula indlela awayenomsa ngayo, umzekelo xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe—isipho somntu owayemi elulwini lokuba angazigcineli nto, kodwa anikele ngayo yonke into ayenayo.

Kodwa masime apha phambi kweVangeli. Masisonddele kwindlu ka Simon umFarisi. Apha sibona umfana onamaqhinga kancinci kumalungiselelo akhe, kodwa kwangelo xesha sibona umfazi owoniweyo esiza ngeenyawo zikaYesu. Akathethi lizwi. Uletha nje ibhotile yee-oyile emhlophe, wenza into enye: ulila kwiinyawo zikaYesu, wazisula ngeenwele zakhe, wazanga, waza wazithambisa. USimon uyazihleba entliziyweni yakhe: 'Ukuba lo mntu wayengumprofeti, wayesazi ukuba lo ngumfazi onjani.' Kodwa uYesu uyayibona intliziyo. Uthetha indaba yamatyala amabini—omnye owedwa amakhulu, omnye owedwa amancinci. Kwaye uYesu uyabuza: 'Ngubani oya kumthanda kakhulu?'

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba le mibuzo ayiphefumli lula kwizindlu zenu namhlanje. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu, ukuba isitulo sakhe esisezantsi singekho, nokuba umoya wakhe usasele phakathi kweendonga zendlu. Usizi aluhambi ngeendlela ezilula. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni, ukuba ingaba sikhona na isigwebo esifihlakeleyo, ukuba ingaba ikhona na into eninokuyenza ngcono ukuze nimsindise. Ndicela niphulaphule amazwi am namhlanje ngokucacileyo: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto nize nenza ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala ncam. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo, olufana nalo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe egameni lakhe eCà Mau, olethela abantu abaswele ubomi.

UYesu uthi kulo mfazi wembandezelo: 'Ukholokazi lakho likusindisile; hamba ngoxolo.' UBen usekhululekile ngoku. Akasabandezeleki. Usebanquet yasezulwini, kufuphi noSanti Carlo Acutis, umfana owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya. Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana onezandla ezivulekileyo. Alan noThao, vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu kule mihla enzima. 

Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala olu thwalo lodwa. UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye uthando lwakhe alusoze luphele. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka ezintliziyweni zethu.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliNgcwele leAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kuMphefumlo wam ngomoya. Ndiyamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, ndizibophelela kuwe ngokupheleleyo; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe naphakade. Amen.
closing: Makube kuye kuse nendawonye nani, kwaye uxolo lukaThixo lumahlulela uBen kwaye lukuphethe ngezandla zakhe ezinobubele namhlanje naphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abaswelekileyo baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu naphakade, siyamcela eNkosini.
Ukuze bonke abasiziweyo nabazalwana abasentlungwini bafumane intuthuzelo namandla avela kuThixo, siyamcela eNkosini.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala (1 Korinte 15:1-11)
readings.text: Ndiyanikhumbuza, bafowethu, iVangeli endayishumayela kuni, enayamkelayo, enimiyo kuyo, enisindiswa ngayo, ukuba niyayibamba intliziyo yamazwi endawashumayela kuni, ngaphandle kokuba nakholwa ngeze. Kuba ndanika kuqala okwamkela nam: ukuba uKristu wafela izono zethu ngokweZibhalo; ukuba watyatywa; ukuba wavuka ngomhla wesithathu ngokweZibhalo; ukuba wabonakala kuKefas, waza wabonakala nakwiShumi elinesibini. Emva koko wabonakala kubazali abangaphezu kwamakhulu amahlanu ngexesha elinye, uninzilwabo olusekhoyo kude kube ngoku, kanti bambwa sele belele. Emva koko wabonakala kuJakobi, waza wabonakala nakubapostile bonke. Okokugqibela, njengomntu ozelwe ngendlela engeyiyo, wabonakala nakum. Kuba ndim omncinci kubapostile, endingafaneleki nokubizwa ngokuba ngumpostile, ngokuba ndatshutshisa ibandla likaThixo. Kodwa ngobubele bukaThixo ndiyile ndiyo, kwaye ububele bakhe obanikezelwa kum abubanga bungenamsebenzi. Eneneni, ndisebenze nzima ngaphezu kwabo bonke; kodwa hayi mna, kungobubele bukaThixo obunam. Ngaloo ndlela, nokuba ngaba ngumna okanye ngabo, sitsho sishumayela, kwaye nitsho nakholwa.

readings.label: INdumiso (Ndumiso 118:1b-2, 16ab-17, 28)
readings.text: Bulekani eNkosini, ngokuba ilungile; ngokuba inceba yayo iyahlala naphezulu. Mayitsho indlu kaSirayeli ukuthi: 'Inceba yayo iyahlala naphezulu.' Isandla sasekunene seNkosi siphakanyisiwe; isandla sasekunene seNkosi senze amandla. Andiyi kufa, kodwa ndiya kuphila, ndivakalise imisebenzi yeNkosi. UnguThixo wam, ndiyakubulela; wena Thixo wam, ndiyakukuphakamisa.

readings.label: IVangeli (Luka 7:36-50)
readings.text: Omnye wabaFarisi wamema uYesu ukuba adle naye, waza wena endlwini yomFarisi wahlala etafuleni. Nanko umfazi ongowesono kuloo mxi wawagqitha owayesazi ukuba uhleli etafuleni endlwini yomFarisi, eze nebhotile yee-oyile emhlophe. Wahlala ngasemva emilenzeni yakhe elila, waqalisa ukuhlamba iinyawo zakhe ngeenyembezi zakhe, wazisula ngeenwele zakhe, wazanga, wazithambisa ngaloo oyile. Xa umFarisi owayemmeme akubonayo oko, watsho ngaphakathi kwakhe wathi: 'Ukuba lo mntu wayengumprofeti, wayesazi ukuba ngumntu onjani nokuba ngumfazi onjani lo umchukumisayo, ukuba ungumoni.' UYesu wamphendula wathi: 'Simoni, ndinelizwi endilifunayo kuwe.' Uthe: 'Litsho, Mfundisi.' 'Abantu ababini babenetyala kumboleki omnye; omnye owayenetyala leentsuku ezingamakhulu amahlanu, omnye amashumi amahlanu. Njengoko babengenandlela yakuhlawula, wazixolela zombini. Ngubani kubo oya kumthanda kakhulu?' USimoni waphendula wathi: 'Ndiba ngulowo uxolelwe okukhulu.' Wathi kuye: 'Ugwebe ngokulungileyo.' Waza wajika kulo mfazi wathi kuSimoni: 'Uyambona lo mfazi? Ndengeza endlwini yakho, akuzange undinike amanzi eenyawo zam, kodwa yena uhlambe iinyawo zam ngeenyembezi zakhe, wazisula ngeenwele zakhe. Akuzange undinike ukwanga, kodwa yena akazange ayeke ukuzanga iinyawo zam ukususela ngexesha endithe ndangena ngalo. Akuzange uthambise intloko yam ngamafutha, kodwa yena uthambise iinyawo zam ngaloo oyile. Ngenxa yoko ndithi kuwe: izono zakhe ezinintshi zixolelwe, ngoko ubonise uthando olukhulu; ke lowo uxolelwe kancinci, uthanda kancinci.' Wathi kuye: 'Izono zakho zixolelwe.' Ababeseetafuleni baqalisa ukuthi ngaphakathi kwabo: 'Ngubani lo othe ade axolele nezono?' Kodwa wathi kulo mfazi: 'Ukholokazi lakho likusindisile; hamba ngoxolo.'

day: Thursday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.
